##Part A - Creating vectors

```{r}
scores <- c(88,92,79,95,84)
subjects <- c("Math", "Science", "English", "History", "PE")
```

```{r}
odds <- seq(1,19, by=2)
vectorA<- seq(0,1, length = 5)
```

```{r}
vectorA <- rep("A",4)
vectorB <- rep(c("A","B"), each =3)
vectorC <- rep(c("A", "B"), 2)
```


##Part B- Subsetting(Accessing) Vectors

```{r}
grades <- c(88,92,79,95,84)
names(grades) <- c("Math", "Science", "English", "History", "PE")
grades[3]
grades[c(1,4)]
grades[c("Science", "PE")]
```
```{r}
grades <- c(88,92,79,95,84)
grades[-c(2,3,5)]
```
```{r}
grades <- c(88,92,79,95,84)
grades[grades >= 85]
```
## C- Vector operations and "append"
```{r}
x <- c(1,2,3,4)
y <- c(10,20,30,40)
x*y
x*2
```
```{r}
z <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6)
short <- c(1,0)
z+short
```
```{r}
fruits <- c("apple", "banana", "cherry")
append(fruits, "date")
append(fruits, "kiwi", after = 1)
```
## D- Lists: Creating and Subsetting
```{r}
student <- list(name = "Maria Santos",
                age = 20,
                grades = c(88,92,79),
                is_enrolled = TRUE
                )
```

```{r}
student <- list(name = "Maria Santos",
                age = 20,
                grades = c(88,92,79),
                is_enrolled = TRUE
                )
student["grades"]
class(student["grades"])
```
```{r}
student <- list(name = "Maria Santos",
                age = 20,
                grades = c(88,92,79),
                is_enrolled = TRUE
                )
student[["grades"]]
class(student[["grades"]])
```
```{r}
student <- list(name = "Maria Santos",
                age = 20,
                grades = c(88,92,79),
                is_enrolled = TRUE
                )
student$name
```
```{r}
student <- list(name = "Maria Santos",
                age = 20,
                grades = c(88,92,79),
                is_enrolled = TRUE
                )
student$grades[2]
```
##Part E - Critical Thinking Challenge
```{r}
inventory <- list(item = c("Notebook", "Pen", "Erases"),
                price = c(25.50, 10.00, 5.00),
                in_stock = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)
                )
inventory$item[inventory$in_stock == TRUE]
```
